title: Go Birds! Radio, Part 1: The AJ Brown Breakup Show
text: James Seltzer and Eliot Shorr-Parks give all their thoughts on the Eagles' trade of AJ Brown and everything that went down following the blockbuster move.

title: Go Birds! Radio, Part 2: Finally, The Right Time To Say Goodbye
text: James Seltzer and Eliot Shorr-Parks put a bow on the end of the AJ Brown era in the second hour of Saturday's radio show.

title: Sean Payton-Davis Webb Broncos offense? Yes, this could work
channel_name: The Broncos Podcast with Troy Renck
text: In my latest Broncos pod powered by Hoggatt Injury Law, I peel back the layers of onion on why the Sean Payton-Davis Webb-Bo Nix could work given the stakes. And who caught our eye at OTAs?
